title: The comparison morphism from the etale site to the Zariski site is flat
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the morphism of ringed sites from the small etale site of S to the small Zariski site of S is flat (statement lines 3220-3224). Flateness here is a statement about the structure sheaf of the etale site viewed as a module over the pullback of the Zariski structure sheaf, so the proof must first identify that pullback: using that etale morphisms are open, it computes it as the sheafification of the presheaf sending an etale V over S to the sections of the Zariski structure sheaf over the image of V (proof lines 3227-3236). It then checks flatness on the members of a suitable covering of each etale V: if both V and its image are affine, the map corresponds to an etale ring map, and etale ring maps are flat, so the comparison map between the two structure sheaves is flat there (proof lines 3237-3242). The remaining point is that every etale V does admit an affine open cover by pieces whose images are affine open in S, which the author proves in a footnote by intersecting with a suitable affine and taking a fibre product; flatness then descends from the covering by the sheafification-and-refinement criterion (proof lines 3243-3252). The claim is H2: three separate verifications are needed, the computation of the pullback sheaf, the flatness of the affine case through the corresponding ring map, and the affineness of the covering used to globalise, and all three are carried out rather than cited.
